name: Elmina Ex
source: One of the Yun Gasol Union Three Musketeers. Elmina was put in charge of the military service and ordered to develop heavy industry. Her task is to manufacture large quantities of new weapons to be sure that military will not lack them. Elmina is noble from aristocratic faction that withdrew from the kingdom Malucia. Their descendants do all what's in their power to respect the will of their ancestors in order to stop Malucia.
